class Mgr { fun getActiveSessions(x: String?): String = "SESSIONS($x)" }
fun peek(c: Class<*>, mgr: Any): Any? {
    val find = Class<*>::getMethod
    val meth = find(c, "getActive" + "Sessions", arrayOf(String::class.java))
    return meth(mgr, null)
}
fun peek2(c: Class<*>, mgr: Any): Any? {
    val meth = c.getMethod ("getActive" + "Sessions", String::class.java)
    return meth(mgr, "y")
}
val a = """x""""
val b = "/*"
val hiddenByRaw = 1
val c2 = "*/"
/* /* */ " */
val b2 = "/*"
val hiddenByNested = 2
val c3 = "*/"
fun main() {
    println(peek(Mgr::class.java, Mgr()))
    println(peek2(Mgr::class.java, Mgr()))
    println("a=[" + a + "] " + hiddenByRaw + " " + hiddenByNested)
}
